small_guidance:
- The post-conv fused kernel is tiny relative to ConvTranspose3d + MaxPool3d which dominate at ~19ms; tuning BLOCK_S/num_warps here will not move fast_p meaningfully. If kept, try BLOCK_S=256, num_warps=8, num_stages=2 and load the subtract vector once per program.
- Fuse MaxPool3d into the post-conv kernel: have one program iterate over the pool window directly on the conv-transpose output, eliminating an intermediate tensor read/write.
large_guidance:
- Replace ConvTranspose3d with a custom Triton scatter-add kernel: one program per (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile) computing the input×weight outer product and scatter-adding into the output grid using stride/padding/output_padding index math. This is the dominant cost (>95% of runtime) and the only path to large speedup.
- Alternatively, implement ConvTranspose3d as a gather-style direct kernel: one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile), iterating over (IC, kD, kH, kW) and gathering from input positions ((od+pad-kd)/stride) where the divisibility check passes. Fuse bias add + MaxPool3d window reduction + softmax(C) + subtract + swish + max(C) all in the epilogue so the intermediate tensors are never materialized.
- Use channels_last3d layout (NDHWC) so the OC/IC GEMM-K axis is contiguous; precompute pooled-output index maps at init and pass as constants.
